children: The mega-bank is eyeing yet another takeover target: Palmer Square, a corporate debt shop that manages $37 bln. Few peers have used their deregulation windfalls so acquisitively. Although boss David Solomon's deal track record is patchy, others may feel pressure to follow.
Full view will be published shortly.

Goldman Sachs is among the leading bidders for Palmer Square Capital, a firm with $37 billion under management that invests primarily in corporate debt, Bloomberg reported on September 22, citing unnamed sources.
